Marta (Eng): Hey @people-ops, quick payroll/tax emergency. My stock vested on 2026-03-01 but I changed my work location from CA to UK on 2026-02-28. The RSU payout shows US federal withholding — worried about double taxation. Can payroll switch this to UK PAYE?
Julian (People Ops): Hi Marta — can you confirm exact move date/time and when you updated your address/profile in the HR system? Also did you opt into UK payroll or submit right-to-work docs before 3/1?
Marta (Eng): Moved 2026-02-28 morning, updated address same day around 09:30 PT. Uploaded passport + biometric right-to-work proof that afternoon. I didn't get a confirmation email for UK payroll enrollment yet.
Priya (Payroll): Thanks. Do you see the RSU on your 2026-03-01 paystub (run pr-20260301)? If it was processed in the US run, we'll need to evaluate reversal + reprocess in UK payroll. Also need to know whether you were UK tax resident on the vest date — we can't change withholding without residency evidence.
Marta (Eng): Yes the RSU shows in pr-20260301. I can DM NI/UTR or provide screenshots of tenancy docs.
Alicia (Tax Counsel): High-level: the taxing country depends on residency and where the employment services were performed. If the UK is primary residence and residency tests are met on 3/1, PAYE is likely appropriate. US withholding could be reclaimed via amended US return or foreign tax credit. We'll consult our external tax advisor for treaty-specific remedy.
Priya (Payroll): Note our UK payroll enrollment cutoffs: enrollment must be active prior to the payroll run to withhold under PAYE automatically. If enrollment completed after the run, we still can submit a reversal and reissue, but timing and eligibility depend on external advisor sign-off.

Julian (People Ops): I checked HR logs: location change recorded 2026-02-28 09:31 PT. UK payroll enrollment initiated same day 14:02 UTC but 'activation' timestamp is 2026-03-05 08:00 UTC.
Marta (Eng): So enrollment activated after the vest date. If UK can't be applied retroactively, what's the usual path? I'm concerned about being out-of-pocket while waiting months for a refund.
Alicia (Tax Counsel): Two possible routes: 1) Retroactive PAYE application if external advisor and HMRC accept it — they sometimes allow corrections with amended payroll submissions. 2) If not possible, reclaiming US withholding via US tax return + foreign tax credit. For near-term cashflow, People Ops/Finance can consider a temporary gross-up or a payroll advance while tax is resolved — subject to policy.
Priya (Payroll): Action plan from payroll: a) Submit reversal request for pr-20260301 to our external payroll tax advisor (submitted). b) If approved, reprocess the RSU payment under UK payroll with PAYE withholding. c) If denied, provide a remediation package (advance or loan) and coordinate US amended filing.
Julian (People Ops): I've opened ticket PO-2026-512 and tagged Priya + Alicia + Finance. Marta, can you DM NI/UTR and a copy of your tenancy/utility bill? We'll attach to the ticket for proof of residency.
Marta (Eng): DMing NI/UTR and upload now. Also would appreciate a note on expected timelines and whether finance can help with cashflow.
Priya (Payroll): Payroll update: reversal_request submitted to tax-advisor 2026-03-02. Expected review time 7–12 business days. If we can reprocess, you'll see a correcting payrun within that window; otherwise Finance will outreach on an interim solution.
